comment: Crossing detection compares the previous reading with this one (CvToGtTr8.cpp:248), so it needs the section in trigger mode and fires when the signal was below the bottom and is now above the top, or the reverse. The min and max knobs have no CV inputs on this module; CV to Gate is the one-section version that does.
